answer: pdf-report costs the most: $6.483 per activation, $6.483 over 16 requests and 1 activation(s).
sql:
SELECT l.skill_name, round(sum(l.cost_usd),3) AS cost_usd, count(*) AS requests,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.name='skill_activated' AND a(e.attrs,'skill.name')=l.skill_name) AS activations,
  round(sum(l.cost_usd) / greatest(1,(SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.name='skill_activated' AND a(e.attrs,'skill.name')=l.skill_name)),3) AS usd_per_activation
FROM llm l WHERE l.skill_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.skill_name ORDER BY usd_per_activation DESC
